executive_summary: Original-release research source audit; no forecasting outcomes used.
availability: original publication date 23:59:59 America/New_York; previous origin weekday 16:00 NY cutoff
origins: first existing frozen cache-ledger origin each calendar month; source_calendar.csv fixed before labels
CV: Separate asset,horizon,annual expanding Ridge; target_end and origin+horizon both strictly before first test cutoff; remove all test-active release IDs from training; mechanically skip unfit early folds
standardization: Train-only StandardScaler with same sample weights as Ridge; constant columns deterministically scale1
release_weights: each active training release total weight1; row weight1/count within asset-horizon-fold
pure_location_shift: frozen draws + predicted delta * original frozen SD; preserve shape/scale/order up to floating point precision
scoring: qfbench2_common v2.4.3 crps_ensemble fair=True, normalize by original frozen past SD*sqrt(horizon); candidate sum / baseline sum on same cells
oracle: translate original median to truth; no shape change; descriptive only

controls.value_shuffle: four economic source values permuted among chronological training releases; original test values and source age intact
controls.date_permutation: permute fixed 0..20 business-day nonnegative publication delays; never early activation; rebuild active release IDs/features/weights; missing source/past training gives zero shift on fixed test ledger
controls.standards_sign: balanced shuffled +- signs by training release applied jointly to standards level and delta
controls.Gaussian: five Gaussian values per release, deterministic same across assets/horizons; same CV and release weights
controls.year_shift: source state exactly one calendar year earlier; same fold/weights, missing gives zero shift
controls.future_mutation: future releases cannot alter earlier features or fixed fitted predictions bitwise
controls.outcome_mutation: changes truth/delta copy, source features unchanged; not a refitting invariance claim

concentration: paired score deletion by release/year; top1/top3 positive gain shares; no refitting or favorable subset selection

success_criteria.STRONG_YES: ratio<=.90, capture>=.20, >=75% annual folds improve, controls clearly inferior, release upper95CI<1, no event concentration
success_criteria.YES: ratio<=.95, capture>=.10, >=60% annual folds improve, controls inferior, no event concentration
success_criteria.WEAK_YES: ratio<=.98, capture>.05, more folds improve, controls inferior, no event concentration
success_criteria.NO: ratio>=1.02 meaningful degradation OR capture<=0 OR controls comparable/better
success_criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise; concentration or near baseline; no model redesign

public_private_firewall: Public prediction/provenance/aggregate artifacts; actual labels and individual scores private
batch_null_solver: identical weighted standardized Ridge normal equation; pre-PRE synthetic comparison to sklearn max8.881784197001252e-16; no alternative model
